description: DRAFT - Woodheater and Open Fire Count per 250m x 250m grid is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. Spatial distribution of woodheaters and open fires (count per 250-m^2) in Tasmania. Rasters created from survey data completed in 2011. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are ATMOSPHERE-Air-Quality, HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT-Planning, POLLUTION-Air. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
